setup: Set the pulley at its highest point
Hold the bar with hands at chest height
Stand tall, slight forward lean, soft knees
Pin your elbows to your sides
execution: Push down until your arms are straight
Keep your elbows still at your sides
Let your hands rise slowly to chest height
faults: Leaning over the bar to push with bodyweight
Letting the stack yank the hands up

notes: Stand where the bar and cable can't hit your face as they come back up.
Straighten your arms fully, but don't snap the elbows hard into lockout.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move

regressions.name: Band triceps pushdown
regressions.reason: Light resistance with a band anchored overhead; no cable station needed.

progressions.name: Overhead cable triceps extension
progressions.reason: Trains the triceps with the arms overhead, a longer range for the long head.

progressions.name: Diamond push-up
progressions.reason: Highest triceps activity of the eight exercises in one ACE-funded EMG study.

substitutions.name: Rope pushdown
substitutions.reason: Same movement with a rope handle. Logged separately because loads can differ.

substitutions.name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension
substitutions.reason: Free-weight triceps work when the cable is busy.

substitutions.name: EZ-bar skull crusher
substitutions.reason: Lying triceps extension with a free bar.

substitutions.name: Dumbbell kickback
substitutions.reason: Free-weight option with similar triceps activity in one EMG study.

guideBrief.cameraNote: Side view, figure facing right toward the cable column, camera at chest height. Cable runs from a high pulley above and slightly in front of the head down to the hands.

keyPositions.label: Start
keyPositions.describe: Standing, feet hip width, knees soft, torso leaning forward about 10–15° from the hips. Upper arms by the sides, elbows close to the ribs. Elbows bent so the hands are at lower-chest height. Wrists straight.

keyPositions.label: Halfway
keyPositions.describe: Forearms angled down, hands moving in an arc in front of the body. Elbows have not moved. Torso unchanged.

keyPositions.label: Bottom
keyPositions.describe: Arms straight, hands in front of the thighs, elbows still at the sides. Wrists straight. Torso unchanged.

guideBrief.barPath: Hands move in an arc around a fixed elbow; elbow drift ≤ 1% of body height
emphasise: Elbow stays pinned; only the forearm moves
Cable line stays attached to the hands
